runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220); glibc 2.42 and musl libresolv APIs inventoried separately

official_documentation_checked.finding: ISO C defines no DNS message type or parser.

glibc ships the BIND 8 ns_initparse/ns_parserr message parser in libresolv and declares it in <arpa/nameser.h>. The glibc manual does not document it; documentation is the BIND 8 resolver heritage and source. Recorded as a runtime lead, not run.
musl provides the same interface in libc. Not run.
